description:
As an Associate Full-Stack Software Engineer II in AbbVie's Business Technology Solutions (BTS) function, you’ll have opportunities to contribute to the digital transformation of a leading biopharma company, helping to create solutions that impact patients and their communities for the better.
 The ideal candidate will excel in delivering adaptable and user-friendly web applications and software solutions that evolve to meet scientists’ and business users’ needs. The successful candidate will work end-to-end across the technology stack, including user interfaces, APIs and backend services, databases, cloud deployment, testing, and production support. We are seeking engineers with strong technical depth in a primary technology stack combined with full-stack breadth, rather than expertise across every technology used within the environment.
 Additionally, the successful candidate will have the ability to independently identify, engineer, and optimize new software solutions to address critical business requirements. A continuous drive to improve existing methods and processes is essential.
 Responsibilities: 
 Independently design, develop, test, deploy, and support software solutions that address scientific or business needs, demonstrating proficiency across front-end development, APIs and backend services, databases, cloud technologies, and software engineering practices.
 Design, develop, and maintain both front-end and back-end components of enterprise applications, contributing across the full technology stack and software development lifecycle.
 Develop and integrate APIs, services, data models, and application components using modern software architecture and engineering patterns.
 Build and support cloud-based applications and services, applying scalable, secure, and maintainable design principles.
 Apply modern DevSecOps practices, including source control, automated testing, CI/CD, security scanning, monitoring, and observability, to improve software quality and reliability.
 Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate software engineering activities while applying appropriate engineering judgment to review, validate, test, and maintain AI-generated code.
 Ensure the security and integrity of software solutions, safeguarding data and system operations.
 Continuously seek learning opportunities to stay current with emerging software engineering, cloud, web, and AI technologies, applying innovative solutions to improve processes and outcomes.
 Use AbbVie values to govern decisions, actions and behaviors, ensuring that work reflects our commitments to Patients, Affordability, Accountability & Service Commitment, Decisiveness, Innovation & Thoughtful Risk while fostering Diversity & Inclusion, Integrity & Respect, Learning, Continuous Improvement & Personal Growth, Teamwork & Collaboration.
 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related field, plus 2 years of experience OR Master’s degree with 0 years of experience.
 Full-stack development experience across front-end, APIs/backend services, databases, testing, and deployment, with strong technical depth in a primary technology stack.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience with AWS cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven architecture, Docker, and API security.
 Experience with DevSecOps tooling, including CI/CD, test automation, security scanning, and application observability.
 Hands-on experience with AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude Code or equivalent and sound judgment in reviewing AI-generated code.
 Experience integrating LLM/AI capabilities into software solutions, including prompt design, tool use, RAG, or memory management.
 Additional experience with technologies such as Blazor, GraphQL, React Native, or modern JavaScript frameworks.
  
 Experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript and React or ASP.NET MVC, plus backend development using C#/.NET, Python, or Node.js.
 Experience with SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including relational database design and query development.
 Familiarity with cloud development, CI/CD, automated testing, and modern software engineering practices.
 Ability to independently develop flexible solutions in a dynamic environment with strong communication, time management, and documentation skills.
 Candidates may bring deep expertise in either a Microsoft .NET-based stack or a React with Python/Node.js-based stack . We expect strong technical depth in one primary stack combined with the breadth to contribute across the full software development lifecycle. Proficiency in both technology stacks is not required.
